description:
Admit patient 'Sarah Connor' to the 'Surgical Ward'. 

1. Search for existing patient 'Sarah Connor' (ID: P-ADT-101).
2. Create a new Visit/Encounter for her.
3. Set the Visit Type to 'Admission' (or 'Inpatient').
4. Set the Location to 'Surgical Ward'.
5. Enter 'Acute Appendicitis' as the Diagnosis or Reason for Visit.
6. Set the Date to today.
7. Save the admission record.
